product_one_liner.value: Scandit’s Smart Data Capture platform uses smart devices to capture barcodes, text, objects, and IDs for frontline workers and businesses, helping automate workflows and improve customer experiences.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes Smart Data Capture as capturing barcodes, text, objects, and IDs on smart devices, and says it empowers frontline workers and improves customer experiences.
